synthesis.body: ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_CLIENT) sets no minimum protocol version, so obsolete TLS is offered; CodeQL flags it as py/insecure-protocol at high severity. ssl.create_default_context() does set TLSv1_2 as the floor, which is why the distinction only shows up on hand-built contexts — including a diagnostic probe that deliberately skips verification. Set ctx.minimum_version = ssl.TLSVersion.TLSv1_2 explicitly whenever constructing a context directly.

title: A bare ssl.SSLContext still permits TLS 1.0 and 1.1
